text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing up my morning work,
I was heading to the cafeteria for lunch when—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: What wonderful weather for a picnic!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Ah, if you feel like taking a nap, just let me know~.
My lap is free for you♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
We're about to eat, so no napping now.
...So, did everyone bring their stuff?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Of course☆

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Everything's perfect~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Alright then, ready, set...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A large picnic sheet is spread out,
and many bento boxes are arranged on top of it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Upon opening the lid, it was packed full
with an appetizing assortment
of colorful side dishes.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer!
Come eat with us, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Food always tastes waaaay better
when we all eat together☆

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, right this way~.
Is there anything you fancy?
I'll dish it out for you~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
No need to hold back!
Eat plenty and prepare for the afternoon.
choice_data_list: Are you bringing lunch to share?
Did you bring lunch to share?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yup! And so, we get together regularly
to swap recipe ideasー♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: The members change from time to time, but we always participate!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I've got more recipes to work with, which helps a lot.
Here, this one's delicious. Give it a try!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It's just simple grilled mountain yam,
but it goes great with aonori, and I made the sweet
sauce extra rich, too~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Add some crispy fried pork belly and
zesty green onions to that,
and it'll whet your appetite even more! ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: "Try some, try some! How is it?!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The pork fat and the sharpness of the green onions intertwine
in an exquisite harmony. The pleasant aroma of aonori, paired
with the refined taste of a sweet sauce that feels uniquely Japanese...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A crisp crunch from the mountain yam, yet it melts with a fluffy, airy texture.
T-This is...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yay!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "The ingredients and seasoning are simple, but you just can't stop eating, right?"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, stuffing your cheeks like that...
Fufu, how cute. There's plenty more, so please take your time eating~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Heh, seeing you eat with such gusto makes cooking it all worthwhile.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I know! Next time, I'll cook something
you really like, Trainer!
Got any requests~?
choice_data_list: A steak that'll build your strength!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Steak! Meat is the best, isn't it~☆
It builds up your strength and makes you feel energized!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Simple is good, but I'd like to try
a few different grilling methods.
How do you like yours cooked?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Having unique sauce options sounds like fun too~♪
What kind of flavors do you like~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"...Ehehe.
Making something for 'someone' feels kind of special, doesn't it?☆"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Not for "everyone," but thinking about what
a specific person would like...
Yeah, this is super fun too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: All riiiight, let's all come up with a delicious new steak recipe together~!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Ooooh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Grateful for the wonderful gathering,
we savored our boxed lunches—spending
a truly perfect afternoon.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Huh, you want it that spicy?
Are you sure? Will you be okay eating it?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heh, sounds good to me.
I'll make it super spicy for you.
Finish every last bite and show me your guts!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Still, a little mildness would be nice too~
Milk works, but if it's for a boxed lunch,
maybe we should go with soy milk~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, don't push yourself too hard, okay!
Eating happily and deliciously comes first! ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: If it's ultra spicy, the kick must be intense too...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
That's it! Let's make the drink lassi.
And while we're at it, instead of just rice,
let's get some sweet naan ready to balance the flavors—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Listening to the three of them chat about recipes made for a delightful afternoon.
